i1.title: Antonio Banderas Queen of Seduction Eau de Toilette 80ml
i1.descriptionHtml:

  • Heart: Jasmine, Iris, Peony, Pink Pepper

  • Brand: Antonio Banderas
  • Concentration: Eau de Toilette
  • Size: 80ml
  • Scent profile: Fruity · Floral · Fresh

Why you'll love it

  • A juicy opening of grapefruit and raspberry
  • A floral heart of jasmine, iris and peony
  • A warm amber finish
  • Light Eau de Toilette for everyday wear

FAQ

What does Queen of Seduction smell like?

Grapefruit, raspberry and water accord first, then jasmine, iris, peony and pink pepper, finishing with amber.

Yes, it is a women's fragrance.
